clips.text: A few things worth knowing. None of them are scary.
It's free. There's nothing to sign up for. No account, no name, no email address.
Your reel is private. Its link is long and random, so nobody can guess it. Only people you send it to can watch.
After thirty days, it's deleted. Or ask Claude to delete it sooner, and it's gone straight away.
And the voice is made by Pixel Reel itself. Your words are never sent off to a voice company.
